title: Rules that are logic become site settings
description:
The two-citation minimum and the point check's verdicts are code, not text, so a scaffold alone cannot change them.

```gherkin
Feature: Idea rules are settings

  Scenario: A site allows one-source ideas
    Given a site whose idea settings need one Reference
    When ideas are generated
    Then an idea built on one Reference is kept

  Scenario: Another site keeps the stricter rule
    Given a site whose idea settings need two References
    When ideas are generated
    Then an idea built on one Reference is dropped
```
